study: A strength shock, D asymmetric response and predeclared no-bet, plus receipt audit
hypothesis: A sequential team strength innovation is defined as prior FT outcome minus Crown-implied pregame margin proxy; test whether it improves time-forward AH margin estimates and executable Crown contract payoff. D tests whether Crown reacts differently to unexpected positive versus negative prior outcomes. The no-bet variant uses fixed contract break-even EV > 0.

limitations: Historical Crown quotes are source-event T1 replays, not actual received HTTP quotes.
Start-to-end line/water adjustment is a retrospective event-path diagnostic; it does not identify causal lag or contemporaneous receipt timing.
Receipt price replays require exact-FID joining to team-and-score history; this score archive has no rows for the 176 unique new MR1 receipt FIDs, so candidate applications are zero.
Team ratings are reconstructed from retrospective score history and have no timestamped contemporaneous snapshot.
No target-year tuning or ROI search.
